introduction: The Global Config Loading system provides a unified configuration loading scheme for the agent-fox CLI suite (`af`, `nightshift`, and `spec`), introducing a shared user-wide baseline config at `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` that is merged with per-repo local configs using shallow section replacement semantics.

glossary.$HOME: User's home directory, resolved via Python's `Path.home()`
glossary.$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml: Path to the global config file
glossary..agent-fox/config.toml: Path to the local (per-repo) config file
glossary.0o700: Unix directory permission mode granting read, write, and execute access to the owner only
glossary.--force: CLI flag that forces overwrite of existing local config during `af init`
glossary.AF_CONFIG: Legacy environment variable previously used by `nightshift` to override the config file path; now deprecated and ignored
glossary.AF_SPEC_MODEL: Environment variable that overrides the Anthropic model used for spec generation, taking highest precedence in the model resolution chain
glossary.AgentFoxConfig: The Pydantic v2 model representing the fully merged and validated configuration for the agent-fox suite
glossary.CWE-59: Common Weakness Enumeration entry for improper link resolution (symlink following); the system rejects symlinks on final config file paths to prevent this vulnerability
glossary.ConfigError: Exception raised by `load_config()` when a config file contains malformed TOML or fails Pydantic validation
glossary.[spec_tool]: TOML section in config.toml for agentspec settings
glossary.af: Main CLI entry point for agent-fox
glossary.af init: The `af` CLI subcommand that scaffolds a new project, creating global and local config files
glossary.agentspec: The agent-fox sub-package responsible for AI-assisted specification generation, formerly reading settings from `~/.af/settings.yaml`
glossary.generate_default_config: Internal function that renders a minimal set of promoted defaults as active TOML values for the global config file
glossary.global config: `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` — the user-wide baseline configuration file shared across all repositories
glossary.load_config: The shared configuration loading function used by all three CLIs to resolve, merge, validate, and return the effective configuration
glossary.local config: `.agent-fox/config.toml` — a per-repository configuration file whose sections override corresponding sections in the global config
glossary.migration fallback: Temporary mechanism that reads `~/.af/settings.yaml` for `[spec_tool]` values when no `[spec_tool]` section is present in the global config
glossary.nightshift: Autonomous fix daemon CLI for agent-fox
glossary.pytest: Python testing framework used for the agent-fox test suite
glossary.settings.yaml: `~/.af/settings.yaml` — legacy YAML file previously used by the `agentspec` package to store model and authentication settings
glossary.shallow section replacement: Merge strategy where a TOML section in the local config entirely replaces the same-named section in the global config; top-level scalar keys in the local config override matching keys in the global config; absent sections and keys are inherited unchanged
glossary.spec: Spec tool CLI for generating and managing specifications
glossary.spec_tool: TOML section `[spec_tool]` within `AgentFoxConfig` that holds agentspec model and authentication settings
glossary.tomlkit: Third-party Python library used for generating and writing TOML files with comment preservation
glossary.tomllib: Python 3.11+ standard-library module for reading TOML files
glossary.~/.af/settings.yaml: Legacy YAML config file for agentspec (see also `settings.yaml` already in glossary)

requirements.title: Unified config loading across all CLIs

user_story.goal: have all three CLIs use the same load_config function with the same global+local merge logic
user_story.benefit: so that configuration behaviour is consistent and predictable regardless of which CLI is invoked

acceptance_criteria.action: is the single shared function called by `af`, `nightshift`, and `spec` at startup to resolve, merge, validate, and return an `AgentFoxConfig`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns a fully validated `AgentFoxConfig` instance or raises `ConfigError`

acceptance_criteria.action: first attempts to load the global config from `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`, then attempts to load the local config from `.agent-fox/config.toml` relative to the current working directory, and merges them using `shallow section replacement` semantics
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns a merged `AgentFoxConfig` with local sections overriding global sections and absent local sections inherited from the global config
acceptance_criteria.trigger: invoked by any of the three CLIs

acceptance_criteria.action: applies validation and in-memory defaults to the merged result via the `AgentFoxConfig` Pydantic model, matching existing post-merge behaviour
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns a validated `AgentFoxConfig` with all defaults applied

edge_cases.action: raises `ConfigError` with a descriptive message if validation fails; otherwise returns the best available `AgentFoxConfig`
edge_cases.error_condition: invoked outside of the `af`, `nightshift`, or `spec` entry points (e.g. imported as a library without a proper working directory)

user_story.role: new user running af for the first time
user_story.goal: have a sensible default global config created automatically at `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
user_story.benefit: so I don't need to set up anything manually before using the CLI

acceptance_criteria.action: creates the `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory with permissions `0o700` if it does not exist, writes a default global config using `generate_default_config`, and uses it as the baseline for the current invocation
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Newly created `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is present on disk; `load_config` returns a valid `AgentFoxConfig` with defaults applied
acceptance_criteria.trigger: $HOME is resolvable and `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` does not exist

acceptance_criteria.action: parses the global config and uses it as the baseline configuration
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns `AgentFoxConfig` reflecting the global config values
acceptance_criteria.trigger: $HOME is resolvable and `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists and is valid TOML

acceptance_criteria.action: skips global config loading entirely, emits a debug-level warning that `$HOME` could not be resolved, and continues using the local config if present or in-memory defaults
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns `AgentFoxConfig` based on local config or defaults; does not raise an exception

edge_cases.action: rejects the file and raises `ConfigError` identifying the path and the `CWE-59` symlink violation
edge_cases.return_contract: Raises `ConfigError` with a message identifying the symlinked global config path

edge_cases.action: raises `ConfigError` with a message identifying the directory and the underlying OS error
edge_cases.error_condition: directory creation for `$HOME/.agent-fox/` fails due to a filesystem permission error

requirements.title: Local config loading and shallow section replacement merge

user_story.goal: have a per-repo `.agent-fox/config.toml` whose sections override specific global config sections
user_story.benefit: so each project can customize behaviour without affecting my global baseline or other repositories

acceptance_criteria.action: parses the local config and merges it with the global config using `shallow section replacement`: each TOML section present in the local config entirely replaces the corresponding global section, top-level scalar keys present in the local config override matching global keys, and sections or keys absent from the local config are inherited unchanged from the global config
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns a merged `AgentFoxConfig` where local-defined sections fully replace global sections and absent local sections are inherited
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `.agent-fox/config.toml` exists in the current working directory and is valid TOML

acceptance_criteria.action: uses the global config (or defaults) without modification and emits a debug-level log line indicating no local config was found
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns `AgentFoxConfig` based solely on the global config or defaults

acceptance_criteria.action: does NOT deep-merge nested keys within a section — a section present in the local config replaces the entire corresponding global section, including all nested keys

edge_cases.action: rejects the file and raises `ConfigError` identifying the path and the `CWE-59` symlink violation
edge_cases.return_contract: Raises `ConfigError` with a message identifying the symlinked local config path

edge_cases.action: does NOT apply symlink rejection to intermediate directories in the global or local config paths — symlink checks apply only to the final config file path

user_story.goal: receive a clear error message when any config file contains invalid TOML
user_story.benefit: so I can quickly identify and fix the offending file without guessing which config is causing the problem

acceptance_criteria.action: raises `ConfigError` immediately, before reading the local config, with a message that identifies the global config file path and the TOML parse error
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Raises `ConfigError` with file path and parse error detail; CLI exits with a non-zero status code

acceptance_criteria.action: raises `ConfigError` with a message that identifies the local config file path and the TOML parse error
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Raises `ConfigError` with file path and parse error detail; CLI exits with a non-zero status code
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: `.agent-fox/config.toml` exists but contains malformed TOML (after global config has been successfully loaded)

acceptance_criteria.action: never attempts a partial load or fallback when a config file that exists contains malformed TOML — it always fails fast with `ConfigError`

user_story.role: nightshift user who previously set AF_CONFIG
user_story.goal: receive a clear deprecation warning when AF_CONFIG is set so I know to migrate my settings
user_story.benefit: so I am not silently broken and can transition to the new global+local loading scheme at my own pace

acceptance_criteria.action: prints a deprecation warning to stderr stating that `AF_CONFIG` is no longer supported and directing the user to move settings to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` or `.agent-fox/config.toml`, then ignores the variable and proceeds with the global+local loading scheme
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Warning written to stderr; `AF_CONFIG` value is not used for any config path resolution
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `AF_CONFIG` environment variable is set in the environment at startup

acceptance_criteria.action: never uses the value of `AF_CONFIG` to determine any config file path, regardless of what value it contains

user_story.role: user managing agentspec model and auth settings
user_story.goal: configure agentspec from a single `[spec_tool]` section inside `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
user_story.benefit: so I no longer need to maintain a separate `~/.af/settings.yaml` file in a different format

acceptance_criteria.action: includes a `spec_tool` sub-config with fields: model (str, default "claude-sonnet-4-6"), auth_method (str, default ""), vertex_project (str, default ""), and vertex_region (str, default "")
accepts an `AgentFoxConfig` (or its `spec_tool` sub-config) as input to its own `load_config` instead of reading `~/.af/settings.yaml` directly

follows the precedence order from highest to lowest: (1) `AF_SPEC_MODEL` environment variable, (2) `[spec_tool]` model from the merged config, (3) `migration fallback` from `~/.af/settings.yaml`, (4) hardcoded default "claude-sonnet-4-6"
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns the resolved model string

acceptance_criteria.action: reads model and auth values from `~/.af/settings.yaml` as a `migration fallback` and emits a deprecation warning to stderr instructing the user to migrate settings to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` under the `[spec_tool]` section
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Deprecation warning written to stderr; `agentspec` proceeds with values from `settings.yaml`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the merged `AgentFoxConfig` has no `[spec_tool]` section configured and `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists

acceptance_criteria.action: uses the value of `AF_SPEC_MODEL` as the model, overriding all file-based and default values
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Returns the `AF_SPEC_MODEL` value as the resolved model string

edge_cases.action: uses the hardcoded default model "claude-sonnet-4-6" with no warning
edge_cases.return_contract: Returns "claude-sonnet-4-6" as the resolved model string
edge_cases.trigger: neither `[spec_tool]` section nor `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists and `AF_SPEC_MODEL` is unset

user_story.role: user or operator diagnosing a configuration issue
user_story.goal: see debug-level log lines identifying each config file found, skipped, or merged
user_story.benefit: so I can understand exactly which files contributed to the effective configuration without enabling verbose output in normal operation

acceptance_criteria.action: emits a debug-level log line containing 'Loaded global config from' followed by the file path
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Log line written at DEBUG level
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a global config file is successfully loaded

acceptance_criteria.action: emits a debug-level log line containing 'Merging local config from' followed by the file path and the list of overridden section names
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Log line written at DEBUG level including the list of overridden section names
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a local config is found and merged

acceptance_criteria.action: emits a debug-level log line containing 'No local config found at' followed by the expected local config path
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Log line written at DEBUG level
acceptance_criteria.trigger: no local config is found at `.agent-fox/config.toml`

acceptance_criteria.action: emits a debug-level warning that `$HOME` could not be resolved and global config loading was skipped
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Warning written at DEBUG level

user_story.role: user running af init in a new repository
user_story.goal: have af init create both a global default config and a local commented-out config template
user_story.benefit: so I can immediately see all available settings and selectively override them without repeating global defaults

acceptance_criteria.action: creates the `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory with `0o700` permissions if needed, then writes a default global config using `generate_default_config` to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is created with active defaults; exit code 0

acceptance_criteria.action: leaves the existing global config unmodified, even when `--force` is passed
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Existing `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is unchanged; exit code 0
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a global config already exists at `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`

acceptance_criteria.action: creates `.agent-fox/config.toml` with all possible config values commented out
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `.agent-fox/config.toml` is created with all values commented out; exit code 0

acceptance_criteria.action: leaves the existing local config unmodified
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Existing `.agent-fox/config.toml` is unchanged; exit code 0
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a local config already exists at `.agent-fox/config.toml` and `--force` is NOT passed

acceptance_criteria.action: overwrites `.agent-fox/config.toml` with a freshly generated template where all values are commented out, without modifying the global config
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: `.agent-fox/config.toml` is overwritten with all values commented out; `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` is unchanged; exit code 0
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a local config already exists at `.agent-fox/config.toml` and `--force` IS passed

edge_cases.action: skips global config creation, emits a debug-level warning, and proceeds to create the local config template only
edge_cases.return_contract: Only local config template is created; no error raised for missing `$HOME`; exit code 0
edge_cases.error_condition: `$HOME` is not resolvable when `af init` is run

requirements.title: No regressions — existing test suite compatibility

user_story.goal: have the full existing test suite pass without modification after implementing global config loading
user_story.benefit: so that all current CLI behaviours are preserved and no existing workflows are broken

acceptance_criteria.action: passes in its entirety without requiring any test file modifications after the global config loading feature is implemented
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: All tests pass with exit code 0 when run via `pytest`

acceptance_criteria.action: preserves all existing post-load validation and default-application behaviours defined by `AgentFoxConfig`, so callers relying on those behaviours see no change

correctness_properties.title: Shallow section replacement idempotency
correctness_properties.for_any: pair of valid global config G and local config L
correctness_properties.invariant: Merging G and L using `shallow section replacement` produces a result where every section present in L exactly equals the corresponding section in the output, every section present in G but absent from L exactly equals the corresponding section in the output, and no section from G that is also in L appears in the output

correctness_properties.title: Global config auto-creation occurs at most once
correctness_properties.for_any: sequence of CLI invocations in a `$HOME`-resolvable environment
correctness_properties.invariant: After the first invocation creates `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`, all subsequent invocations load the existing file without overwriting it

correctness_properties.title: AF_SPEC_MODEL always wins model resolution
correctness_properties.for_any: any configuration of `[spec_tool]` in the merged config and any state of `~/.af/settings.yaml`
correctness_properties.invariant: When `AF_SPEC_MODEL` is set, the resolved model string always equals the value of `AF_SPEC_MODEL`, regardless of any file-based configuration or defaults

correctness_properties.title: Fail-fast on malformed TOML: no partial load
correctness_properties.for_any: any config file path that exists and contains malformed TOML
correctness_properties.invariant: `load_config` raises `ConfigError` and the returned `AgentFoxConfig` is never used; no partial configuration derived from the malformed file is observable by the caller

correctness_properties.title: Symlink rejection is limited to the final file path
correctness_properties.for_any: any global or local config file path
correctness_properties.invariant: Symlink detection is applied only to the final config file inode; intermediate directories in the path are never checked for symlink status

correctness_properties.title: af init never overwrites global config
correctness_properties.for_any: any invocation of `af init`, with or without `--force`, regardless of the current state of `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
correctness_properties.invariant: If `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists before `af init` is called, it has identical content after `af init` completes

execution_paths.title: Zero-config first run: auto-create global config and succeed

steps.action: runs `af` (or `nightshift` or `spec`) in a directory with no local or global config
resolves `$HOME` successfully
detects that `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` does not exist
creates the `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory with `0o700` permissions
writes default global config via `generate_default_config` to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
emits DEBUG log: Loaded global config from `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
detects no local config at `.agent-fox/config.toml` and emits DEBUG log
validates the config via `AgentFoxConfig` and returns it
continues execution with the default `AgentFoxConfig`

execution_paths.title: Global + local config merge with section override

steps.action: runs `af` in a repository that has `.agent-fox/config.toml` defining an `[orchestrator]` section
resolves `$HOME` and loads `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` as the baseline
emits DEBUG log: Loaded global config from `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
detects and parses `.agent-fox/config.toml`
applies `shallow section replacement`: replaces global `[orchestrator]` section entirely with local `[orchestrator]` section; inherits all other global sections unchanged
emits DEBUG log: Merging local config from `.agent-fox/config.toml` (sections overridden: [orchestrator])
validates the merged result via `AgentFoxConfig` and returns it
continues execution with the merged `AgentFoxConfig`
runs `af` with `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` containing invalid TOML syntax
resolves `$HOME` and attempts to parse `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
detects TOML parse error and raises `ConfigError` identifying the file path and parse error detail
catches `ConfigError` and exits with a non-zero status code, printing the error message to stderr

execution_paths.title: AF_CONFIG set — deprecation warning then ignored

steps.action: runs `nightshift` with `AF_CONFIG` environment variable set to a custom path
detects `AF_CONFIG` is present in the environment
prints deprecation warning to stderr: `AF_CONFIG` is no longer supported; directs user to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` or `.agent-fox/config.toml`
ignores the `AF_CONFIG` value and proceeds with the global+local loading scheme
loads global config from `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` and merges local config if present
continues execution with the resolved `AgentFoxConfig`

execution_paths.title: agentspec model resolution with migration fallback

steps.action: runs `spec` in a repo where `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` exists but has no `[spec_tool]` section, and `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists
loads and merges global and local configs; `AgentFoxConfig` has `spec_tool` fields at default values
detects no `[spec_tool]` section was explicitly configured in the merged config
detects `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists and reads model/auth values from it as `migration fallback`
emits deprecation warning to stderr instructing user to migrate settings to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` under `[spec_tool]`
uses the model resolved from `settings.yaml` for the spec generation request

execution_paths.title: af init with no existing configs

steps.action: runs `af init` in a new repository with no existing global or local config
resolves `$HOME` and detects no global config at `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
creates `$HOME/.agent-fox/` directory with `0o700` permissions and writes default global config
detects no local config at `.agent-fox/config.toml`
creates `.agent-fox/config.toml` with all config values commented out
exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: af init --force regenerates local config only

steps.action: runs `af init --force` in a repository with both global and local configs already present
detects existing global config at `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` and skips it without modification
overwrites `.agent-fox/config.toml` with a freshly generated template where all values are commented out
exits with code 0; global config is unchanged, local config is regenerated
runs `af` in a restricted CI container where `$HOME` is not set or resolvable
attempts to resolve `$HOME` and fails
emits a debug-level warning that `$HOME` could not be resolved and global config loading is skipped
checks for local config at `.agent-fox/config.toml`; uses it if present, otherwise uses in-memory defaults
continues execution normally without raising an exception

error_handling.behavior: `load_config` raises `ConfigError` immediately with a message identifying the global config file path and the TOML parse error; the CLI exits with a non-zero status code before reading any local config

error_handling.condition: `.agent-fox/config.toml` contains malformed TOML (after global config loaded successfully)
error_handling.behavior: `load_config` raises `ConfigError` with a message identifying the local config file path and the TOML parse error; the CLI exits with a non-zero status code
`load_config` raises `ConfigError` identifying the path and the `CWE-59` symlink violation; the CLI exits with a non-zero status code
`load_config` raises `ConfigError` identifying the path and the `CWE-59` symlink violation; the CLI exits with a non-zero status code

error_handling.condition: `$HOME` is not resolvable at CLI startup
error_handling.behavior: `load_config` emits a debug-level warning, skips global config loading, and continues using local config or in-memory defaults without raising an exception

error_handling.condition: Directory creation for `$HOME/.agent-fox/` fails due to a filesystem permission error
error_handling.behavior: `load_config` raises `ConfigError` with a message identifying the directory and the underlying OS error

A deprecation warning is printed to stderr explaining that `AF_CONFIG` is no longer supported, directing the user to `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml` or `.agent-fox/config.toml`; the variable is then ignored and the global+local loading scheme proceeds

error_handling.condition: No `[spec_tool]` section in merged config and `~/.af/settings.yaml` exists
error_handling.behavior: `agentspec` uses `settings.yaml` values as a `migration fallback` and emits a deprecation warning to stderr instructing the user to migrate to `[spec_tool]` in `$HOME/.agent-fox/config.toml`
